0.original: Jantellot will not stop moaning about his leg.

1.original: Jantellot tells you that, despite his remarkable combat abilities, he has suffered injury at the claws of a monstrous dragon. He bids you fetch some healing spring water from Dragonspit, supplying you with a bottle for the purpose.

2.original: You fill the bottle with water from the spring. Return it to Jantellot so that he might regain his strength.

3.original: You provide Jantellot with the spring's healing water. He explains that, while the Convictory's supplies─particularly of healing potions─are low, the water you retrieved is more effective than the strongest of potions...or so some people say.

48.original: Unnngh... My leg... That last dragon made quite a mess of it.

49.original: Had it happened to anyone else, I daresay they'd have been made a meal of. Fortunately, I'm made of sterner stuff and got away with no more than a flesh wound to show for it.

50.original: I'm keen to get back out there and hunt that bastard down, but I shan't be going anywhere until this leg heals up... Say, do you think you could fetch something for me?

51.original: The waters of Dragonspit are said to have healing properties. If I had some of that, I'd be back on my feet in no time. Take this bottle and fill it with water from that spring, would you?

52.original: Head up to Dragonspit and fetch me some of that renowned spring water. I can't stand to sit around here a moment longer!

53.original: Do you have that spring water? I need to get back out there. I'm sick of seeing those dragons strut about without a care in the realm!

54.original: Good, good. And not a moment too soon─I fear those dragons are starting to forget the taste of Ishgardian steel. After a few applications of this, I'll be ready to get back out there and give them a sharp reminder.

55.original: They say this stuff is better than any potion. It's just as well, given how meager our supplies have been getting lately.
